identity: Independent protocol. Does not reopen v6 or v6b.
variant_b: L_comp + lambda_soft * mean softplus((m_clean - m_adv) / 1), tokens include one EOS
variant_c: B plus beta * L1(real FastV page soft mass, clean page soft mass)
selector: step>0, uint8 nonzero, valid, Full exact, uint8 Linf<=8/255; ascending margin then earlier step; replay after pick; no repick
pollution_rule: Among strict successes, count a sample when the normalized clean FastV text and the attacked FastV text are different and one is a substring of the other.
noise_control: Read-only v5b results/random_noise.csv strict column, paired by sample_id. Significant if attack strict count exceeds noise and exact McNemar two-sided p < 0.05.
